description:
Viridien ( www.viridiengroup.com ) is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges. 
 Job details: 

 The role 

 Viridien, a leader in subsurface imaging, has been building seismic foundation models: models that learn representations of the subsurface from one of the largest, highest-quality proprietary seismic data in the industry, and that adapt to many downstream interpretation and imaging tasks with few labels or zero-shot.

 These models are primarily vision-oriented, treating seismic data as volumetric image data, and we are increasingly exploring multimodal extensions that incorporate additional data types such as well logs, velocity models and geological metadata.

 The central research challenge is not simply to train larger models, but to determine what the model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its ability to generalize across surveys, geological settings and downstream tasks. Rigorous understanding of what the model learns and where it generalizes is precisely how we earn a model reliable enough to trust on unseen surveys in production.

 You will work at the intersection of ML research and seismic imaging production, with access to that proprietary dataset and to substantial on-prem GPU capacity. You will own research hypotheses, model implementations and controlled experiments, working closely with geophysicists and geoscience specialists. No prior seismic expertise is required: our geoscientists will support you in building the domain knowledge you need.

 We welcome strong early-career researchers as well as more experienced ones, with or without a PhD.. Scientific rigor matters more to us than years of experience.

 What you do 

 • Advance understanding of what a seismic foundation model learns, where it fails, and how to improve its generalization across surveys and geological settings.
 • Design, implement and improve model architecture, pre-training objectives and training-data strategies.
 • Establish generalization on independent seismic surveys against meaningful benchmarks and help define the evaluation protocol.
 • Diagnose model limitations and work with our ML engineers and geoscience specialists to improve reliability.

 Required 

 • PhD (completed or near completion) in geophysics, applied mathematics, physics, computer science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent demonstrated research experience (e.g., a strong publication or open-source research record, or substantial research work in industry).
 • Demonstrated depth in computer vision, including vision transformers and self-supervised or representation learning for image or volumetric data, with the ability to justify training objectives and evaluation methods for scientific signal or image data.
 • Evidence of strong scientific problem-solving: forming testable hypotheses, designing controlled experiments, interpreting results critically, and learning from approaches that do not work.
 • Strong hands-on PyTorch skills: implementing, debugging and evaluating research models, with experience optimizing training for limited GPU memory and compute.
 • Ability to collaborate with geoscience specialists and to communicate technical assumptions and limitations clearly.
  
 Preferred (a plus, not required) 

 • Experience with large-scale or distributed (multi-GPU / multi-node) training and the data pipelines it depends on.
 • Experience with multimodal learning or cross-modal representation alignment.
 • Prior exposure to seismic, geophysical or other scientific imaging data
 • Experience taking research models toward production or deployment.
 • Publications at strong machine-learning or scientific venues, or meaningful open-source contributions.
 • Familiarity with foundation-model pre-training at scale.

 What we offer 

 • Access to one of the largest, highest-quality proprietary seismic datasets in the industry.
 • Substantial dedicated on-prem GPU capacity.
 • A genuine research mandate to turn advanced FWI imaging into actionable exploration insights and drilling prospects.

 Houston Benefits: 
 401k Retirement Plan - when you contribute up to 5%, not only will we match that, but we will also add an additional 2%
 Free on-site fitness centre offering group exercise classes
 Short-term disability and long-term disability coverage at no cost to you
 Parental Leave Program allowing mothers and fathers to take time off from work for childbirth, adoption and to bond with your new child
 Pet Insurance – options to meet every budget
 Wellness Program – resources provided to support your personal wellness and participation in activities can earn you $65 quarterly.
 
 
 Our Hiring Process 
 
 At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.
 Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.
 
 We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.
 
 We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.
